'''Estalle Balis''' was a [[High Lady]] of [[House Mecetti]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was the director of [[High Lord]] [[Bodé Leobund XI]]'s spynet and a member of the [[Mecrosa Order]].<ref name="LOTE" />
